title: Ming Foundation Authority Manifest
purpose: Machine-readable three-class authority model and canonical bridge rule. Semantics for cross-repository compatibility; not a conformance or certification claim.

canonical_bridge.foundation: defines what must never be violated
canonical_bridge.mingos: defines how authority, evidence, memory, context and correction travel across spaces
canonical_bridge.products: decide how to help within those boundaries

forbidden_upgrade: a product field -> a MingOS object -> a Foundation rule

hard_invariant.note: An ordinary product preference must not be dressed up as a hard invariant.

adaptive_default.binding: guides ordinary cross-space interaction; does not prescribe a product outcome
adaptive_default.note: Foundation acknowledges this layer but must not promote every adaptive default into a permanent Foundation rule.

product_owned_choice.note: These do not automatically become MingOS Core primitives or Foundation rules because the current implementation works.

semantic_compatibility_contract.rule: Upstream work is triggered only when a semantic boundary changes, not by implementation churn.

non_claims: current product implementation is already a generic MingOS or Foundation standard

evidence_gate.real_family_evidence: unknown at Foundation level; Family-Space CURRENT_PROJECT_STATUS.md is the product fact source
